register.title: Create new instance
register.introHtml: An instance is your own space for your orchestra, choir or group. This is where you manage members, events and attendance.
register.joinHeading: Do you want to join an existing instance?
register.joinText: Ask the person in charge to invite you by email. You only need a new instance if you want to be an administrator yourself.
register.helpGeneral: Ideal for clubs, teams or other groups.
register.helpChoir: Optimised for choirs with voice sections (soprano, alto, tenor, bass).
register.helpOrchestra: Optimised for orchestras/music groups with instrument sections.
register.fullNameHelper: The name is shown in the app
register.mainGroupInfoHtml:
What is the main group?

The main group is a special group for people in a leading role (e.g. conductors, choir directors, board).

Special features:

  • Cannot be deleted
  • Members automatically get extended rights
  • Ideal for people who manage the instance

You can add more groups (e.g. soprano, violins) later.
